title: Mouse Without Borders 0.1 Test 3
summary: This is an unsigned test build of the standalone green Mouse Without Borders fork. Download `MouseWithoutBorders.exe` from Assets and use this same release on every computer.
changes: Opens the machine matrix directly after the portable/install choice instead of showing the legacy blue setup wizard.
Shows this computer's Windows name and the exact portable and installed preferences paths on the first-launch screen.
Rejects checked machine tiles with blank or duplicate names instead of silently changing the layout.
Shows plain-language waiting, connecting, connected, key-mismatch, timeout, error, and disconnected states on the machine tiles.
Removes the obsolete Go through the setup experience link.
Restores the original classic 32x32 pixel icon exactly, changing only its orange artwork to green.
testing: Start in a new empty folder with no `MouseWithoutBorders.prefs.json` and confirm the first-launch screen shows this computer's name and both preferences paths.
Choose Run portable here and confirm the Machine Setup window opens directly, the generated key is visible, and the blue wizard never appears.
Confirm the Go through the setup experience link is gone and the EXE, title-bar, and tray icons use the same classic green pixel design.
Use this same Test 3 EXE on both computers, enter the same key and each other's Windows names, apply the layout, and confirm both machine tiles report Connected.
Temporarily enter a different key on one computer and confirm Key mismatch appears, then restore the shared key.
Test mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file transfer, reconnect, and sleep/wake between the two computers.
